events.title: Aristotle's Physics
events.description: Aristotle wrote his major work on the principles of nature.

events.title: Archimedes' Principle
events.description: The discovery of the law of buoyancy by Archimedes of Syracuse.

events.title: Eratosthenes Calculates Earth's Circumference
events.description: The ancient Greek polymath used shadows to estimate the size of the Earth.

events.title: Al-Khwarizmi's Algebra
events.description: The Persian mathematician wrote the foundational text on algebra.

events.title: Alhazen's Book of Optics
events.description: The foundational work on optics and the scientific method.

events.title: Copernicus' Heliocentric Model
events.description: Nicolaus Copernicus published 'On the Revolutions of the Heavenly Spheres'.

events.title: Vesalius' De Humani Corporis Fabrica
events.description: The first modern book on human anatomy was published.

events.title: Kepler's Laws of Planetary Motion
events.description: Johannes Kepler published the first two laws of planetary motion.

events.title: Galileo's Sidereus Nuncius
events.description: Galileo Galilei published his telescopic observations of the Moon, Jupiter, and stars.

events.title: Harvey's Circulation of Blood
events.description: William Harvey described the systemic circulation of blood in the body.

events.title: Hooke's Micrographia
events.description: Robert Hooke published his microscopic observations, coining the term 'cell'.

events.title: Newton's Principia
events.description: Isaac Newton established the laws of motion and universal gravitation.

events.title: Lavoisier's Elements of Chemistry
events.description: Antoine Lavoisier defined the modern system of chemical nomenclature.

events.title: Edward Jenner's Smallpox Vaccine
events.description: The first successful vaccine was developed.

events.title: Dalton's Atomic Theory
events.description: John Dalton proposed that matter is composed of atoms.

events.title: Discovery of Electromagnetism
events.description: Hans Christian Ørsted discovered that electric currents create magnetic fields.

events.title: Faraday's Law of Induction
events.description: Michael Faraday discovered electromagnetic induction.

events.title: Darwin's On the Origin of Species
events.description: Charles Darwin proposed the theory of evolution by natural selection.

events.title: Maxwell's Equations
events.description: James Clerk Maxwell unified electricity, magnetism, and light as electromagnetism.

events.title: Mendel's Laws of Inheritance
events.description: Gregor Mendel published his work on the genetics of pea plants.

events.title: Mendeleev's Periodic Table
events.description: Dmitri Mendeleev organized the chemical elements into a periodic table.

events.title: Koch's Germ Theory
events.description: Robert Koch proved that specific microorganisms cause specific diseases.

events.title: Hertz Discovers Radio Waves
events.description: Heinrich Hertz experimentally confirmed the existence of electromagnetic waves.

events.title: Roentgen Discovers X-rays
events.description: Wilhelm Conrad Roentgen discovered the first form of ionizing radiation.

events.title: Becquerel Discovers Radioactivity
events.description: Henri Becquerel discovered spontaneous radioactivity in uranium.

events.title: Thomson Discovers the Electron
events.description: J.J. Thomson identified the first subatomic particle.

events.title: Planck's Quantum Hypothesis
events.description: Max Planck proposed that energy is radiated in discrete units or quanta.

events.title: Einstein's Special Relativity
events.description: Albert Einstein published his theory on space, time, and the speed of light.

events.title: Photoelectric Effect Explained
events.description: Einstein explained the photoelectric effect using the concept of light quanta.

events.title: Rutherford Discovers the Atomic Nucleus
events.description: The gold foil experiment revealed the dense center of the atom.

events.title: Wegener's Continental Drift
events.description: Alfred Wegener proposed that the continents were once joined in a single landmass.

events.title: Bohr Model of the Atom
events.description: Niels Bohr proposed that electrons orbit the nucleus in discrete levels.

events.title: Einstein's General Relativity
events.description: Einstein's theory of gravitation as the curvature of spacetime.

events.title: Noether's Theorem
events.description: Emmy Noether linked symmetry in physics to conservation laws.

events.title: Hubble's Discovery of Other Galaxies
events.description: Edwin Hubble proved that Andromeda is a separate galaxy beyond the Milky Way.

events.title: Heisenberg's Uncertainty Principle
events.description: Werner Heisenberg established the limits of precision in quantum measurements.

events.title: Fleming Discovers Penicillin
events.description: Alexander Fleming discovered the first antibiotic substance.

events.title: Hubble's Law
events.description: Hubble discovered that the universe is expanding.

events.title: Discovery of the Neutron
events.description: James Chadwick discovered the neutral subatomic particle in the nucleus.

events.title: Discovery of Nuclear Fission
events.description: Otto Hahn and Fritz Strassmann discovered the splitting of heavy atomic nuclei.

events.title: Miller-Urey Experiment
events.description: Demonstrated that organic compounds could be formed from inorganic precursors.

events.title: DNA Structure Discovered
events.description: Watson, Crick, Franklin, and Wilkins identified the double helix structure of DNA.

events.title: Plate Tectonics Theory
events.description: The modern theory describing the large-scale motion of Earth's lithosphere.

events.title: Penzias and Wilson Discover CMB
events.description: The discovery of the cosmic microwave background radiation confirmed the Big Bang.

events.title: Quarks Proposed
events.description: Murray Gell-Mann and George Zweig proposed the existence of quarks.

events.title: First Recombinant DNA
events.description: Paul Berg created the first DNA molecule containing parts from different organisms.

events.title: Discovery of the W and Z Bosons
events.description: Confirmed the electroweak unification theory.

events.title: Human Genome Project Completion
events.description: The entire human genome was sequenced and mapped.

events.title: Discovery of the Higgs Boson
events.description: The ATLAS and CMS experiments at CERN confirmed the existence of the 'God particle'.

events.title: First Detection of Gravitational Waves
events.description: LIGO detected ripples in spacetime from merging black holes.
